title: Nourishing Roasted Kenyan Rice Vermicelli Noodles
description: A light and flavorful Kenyan dish featuring roasted rice vermicelli noodles, cooked to perfection in a terracotta dish using a bain-marie method, this low-calorie-friendly meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a terracotta dish, heat the olive oil over low heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute
Add the rice vermicelli noodles and cook for 2 minutes
In a separate pot, bring the vegetable broth to a boil
Place the terracotta dish over the pot of boiling broth, creating a bain-marie
Cover the dish with a lid and roast in the preheated oven for 15 minutes
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
